name: at.lucando/text-to-speech
title: Lucando Text to Speech
description: German text-to-speech: 10 natural voices, MP3/WAV download links, processed in Austria.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the German text-to-speech voices available in the user's Lucando account (public voices and the user's own cloned voices). Returns voice id, name, gender, style, typical use and a public MP3 sample link. The voice id is the value text_to_speech expects.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Show the user's Lucando plan and how many characters are left this month (1 character of text = 1 character; transcription costs 300 characters per started minute). Read-only.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Turn German text into speech with a Lucando voice and return a download link to the audio file (valid 24 hours). Uses the user's character balance (one character per character of text; pause marks like [Pause 2 s] are free). Max 20,000 characters per call. Formats: mp3 (default), wav, telefon (WAV 8 kHz for phone systems), alaw, ulaw. If the file is not ready within about 25 seconds, the result contains the job id and its status, and get_job returns the link once it is done. Every file carries an inaudible 'AI-generated' watermark as required by the EU AI Act.

text.description: German text to speak. Numbers and dates are spoken in German words.

voice.description: Voice id from list_voices. Optional; default is the most used public voice.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the status of a Lucando job (text_to_speech or a transcription started on lucando.at) and, when finished, the download link(s); for transcriptions also the text. Read-only.

job_id.description: Job id returned by text_to_speech or list_recent_jobs.

tools.name: list_recent_jobs
tools.description: List the user's 10 most recent Lucando jobs (speech and transcriptions) with id, kind, status and date, newest first. Read-only. Download links come from get_job.
